source_limitations: Historical exports omit the LED ring module and its mount posts; they are not represented in either reference and must be removed from the physical PCB for the strip version. Wires, solder blobs, actual cable plugs, adhesive and print tolerances are not represented. Both files are board-layout references, not a measurement identifying which smaller revision the owner has.
